questions.question: For A = 30°, find the value of: (-3sin²2A+2sec²A-tanfrac{3A)/(2)}{(1)/(3)sin3A}
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Substitute A = 30° directly into the given expression.

Numerator = −3×sin²60° + 2×sec²30° − tan45° = −3×(3/4) + 2×(4/3) − 1 = −7/12.

Denominator = (1/3)×sin90° = 1/3.

Result = (−7/12) ÷ (1/3) = −7/4.

**∴ The correct answer is −7/4.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

A = 30°

Expression: [−3sin²2A + 2sec²A − tan(3A/2)] / [(1/3)sin3A]

**Calculation:**

⇒ Substitute A = 30° into the individual terms:

⇒ sin(2A) = sin(2 × 30°) = sin(60°) = √3/2

⇒ sec(A) = sec(30°) = 2/√3

⇒ tan(3A/2) = tan(3 × 30° / 2) = tan(45°) = 1

⇒ sin(3A) = sin(3 × 30°) = sin(90°) = 1

⇒ Now substitute these values back into the expression:

⇒ Numerator = −3×(√3/2)² + 2×(2/√3)² − 1

⇒ Numerator = −3×(3/4) + 2×(4/3) − 1

⇒ Numerator = −9/4 + 8/3 − 1

⇒ LCM of 4 and 3 is 12.

⇒ Numerator = (−27 + 32 − 12) / 12 = −7/12

⇒ Denominator = (1/3) × 1 = 1/3

⇒ Final Value = (−7/12) / (1/3)

⇒ Final Value = (−7/12) × 3 = −7/4

**∴ The correct answer is −7/4.**

sec(θ) = 1/cos(θ), cosec(θ) = 1/sin(θ), and cot(θ) = 1/tan(θ). Since cos(30°) = √3/2, sec(30°) = 2/√3.

The in-radius and circumradius of a right-angled triangle is 3 cm and 12.5 cm, respectively. The area of the triangle is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The In-radius and circumradius of a right-angle triangle is 3 cm and 12.5 cm.

**Concept used:**

Inradius of right-angle triangle = (P + B - H)/2

Circumradius of a right angle triangle = H/2

Area of a right angle triangle = (1/2 × P × B)

Where,

P = Perpendicular

B = Base

H = Hypotenuse

**Calculation:**

According to the question

Inradius of right-angle triangle = (P + B – H)/2

⇒ (P + B – H)/2 = 3

⇒ P + B – H = 6 ....(1)

Circumradius of a right angle triangle = H/2

⇒ H/2 = 12.5

⇒ H = 25

Putting the value of H in equation (1)

⇒ P + B – 25 = 6

⇒ P + B = 31

Now,

⇒ (P² + B²) = (25)²

⇒ P² + B² = 625

P + B = 31

⇒ (P + B)² = (31)²

⇒ P² + B² + 2PB = 961

⇒ 2PB = 961 – 625

⇒ PB = 168

So, area of triangle = 1/2 × PB

⇒ (1/2 × 168) = 84 cm² 

**∴ The area of the triangle is 84 cm2 **

questions.question: If a + b = 24 and a² + b² = 306, where a > b, then the value of 4a - 5b is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

a + b = 24

a² + b² = 306

**Concept used:**

(a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab

(a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculation:**

a + b = 24

⇒ (a + b)² = 576

⇒ a² + b² + 2ab = 576

⇒ 306 + 2ab = 576

⇒ 2ab = 270

Now,

(a - b)² = a² + b² - 2ab

⇒ (a - b)² = 306 – 270

⇒ (a - b)² = 36

⇒ (a - b) = 6

So, a and b is 15 and 9

4a – 5b = 4 × 15 – 5 × 9

⇒ 60 – 45

⇒ 15

**∴**** Required answer is 15**

questions.question: What is the coefficient of y² in the expansion of (√2y² - 5√3)³?
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

To find the **coefficient** of y² in the **expansion** of (√2y² − 5√3)³, use the term 3ab² from the **algebraic identity** (a − b)³.

Here, a = √2y² and b = 5√3.

Required term = 3 × (√2y²) × (5√3)² ⇒ 3 × √2y² × 75 = 225√2 y².

**∴ The correct answer is 225√2.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:** The expression is (√2y² − 5√3)³.

**Formula Used:** (a − b)³ = a³ − 3a²b + 3ab² − b³

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let a = √2y² and b = 5√3.

⇒ Expansion = (√2y²)³ − 3(√2y²)²(5√3) + 3(√2y²)(5√3)² − (5√3)³

⇒ Term 1 = (√2)³(y²)³ = 2√2 y⁶

⇒ Term 2 = −3(2y⁴)(5√3) = −30√3 y⁴

⇒ Term 3 = 3(√2y²)(25 × 3) = 3 × 75 × √2 y² = 225√2 y²

⇒ Term 4 = −(125 × 3√3) = −375√3

⇒ The full expansion is: 2√2 y⁶ − 30√3 y⁴ + 225√2 y² − 375√3.

⇒ The **coefficient** of the y² term is 225√2.

**∴ The correct answer is 225√2.**

**__Additional Information__**

Binomial Theorem for Positive Integer

The **general term** in the expansion of (x + y)ⁿ is Tᵣ₊₁ = ⁿCᵣ xⁿ−r yr.

Algebraic Cubing Identities

(a + b)³ = a³ + 3a²b + 3ab² + b³ and (a − b)³ = a³ − 3a²b + 3ab² − b³.

Power Rules

For any variables or constants, (xa)b = xa × b and (xy)a = xaya.</p

questions.question: The distance between two equal parallel chords of a circle is 10 cm. If the chords are 24 cm long, then what is the length of the radius?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Equal parallel chords are on opposite sides of the center and equidistant from it.

Distance from center to each chord = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 cm.

Half the length of the chord = 24 ÷ 2 = 12 cm.

Radius r = √(12² + 5²) = √(144 + 25) = √169 = 13 cm.

**∴ The correct answer is 13 cm.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Length of equal parallel chords AB and CD = 24 cm

Distance between chords (MN) = 10 cm

**Formula Used:**

A perpendicular drawn from the center to a chord bisects the chord.

Pythagoras Theorem: Hypotenuse² = Perpendicular² + Base²

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let O be the center of the circle.

⇒ Since the parallel chords are of equal length, they are located on opposite sides and are equidistant from the center.

⇒ Distance from center to chord OM = Total Distance MN ÷ 2 = 10 ÷ 2 = 5 cm.

⇒ The perpendicular OM bisects the chord AB, so AM = AB ÷ 2 = 24 ÷ 2 = 12 cm.

Equal Parallel Chords

If two parallel chords of a circle are equal in length, they must be situated at equal distances from the center and lie on opposite sides of the center.

questions.question: Sachin alone can complete a piece of work for Rs. 8,500 in 8(1)/(2) days. But with the help of Vishnu, the work is completed in 6 days. The share to be paid to Vishnu is:
questions.solution:
__Shortcut Trick__

Efficiency ratio of **Sachin** : (**Sachin** + **Vishnu**) = 1 ÷ (17/2) : 1 ÷ 6 = 2/17 : 1/6 = 12 : 17.

**Vishnu** share of efficiency = 17 parts − 12 parts = 5 parts.

Total 17 units corresponds to the total wage of ₹8,500.

1 unit = ₹8,500 ÷ 17 = ₹500.

**Vishnu** share = 5 units × ₹500 = ₹2,500.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,500.**

**__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by **Sachin** alone = 17/2 days.

Time taken by (**Sachin** + **Vishnu**) together = 6 days.

Total contract amount for the **work** = ₹8,500.

**Formula Used:**

Wages are distributed in the ratio of **Efficiency** when the workers work for the same duration. **Efficiency** = 1 ÷ **Time taken**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e314ba50302fac6d68fa44d8f180c2ac23a17e2eaf3417c831a7a16fcb817403.png] 

**Calculations:**

⇒ **Sachin's** 1-day work = 1 ÷ (17/2) = 2/17 units.

⇒ (**Sachin** + **Vishnu**)'s 1-day work = 1/6 units.

⇒ **Vishnu's** 1-day work = (1/6) − (2/17) = (17 − 12) / (6 × 17) = 5/102 units.

⇒ Ratio of **Efficiency** (**Sachin** : **Vishnu**) = (2/17) : (5/102).

⇒ Multiply by 102 to simplify: (2/17 × 102) : (5/102 × 102) = 12 : 5.

⇒ **Vishnu's** share = (5 / (12 + 5)) × 8500 = (5/17) × 8500.

⇒ **Vishnu's** share = 5 × 500 = ₹2,500.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2,500.**

**__Additional Information__**

Work and Wages Relationship

Wages are directly proportional to the amount of work done. If people work for the same time, the ratio of their wages is equal to the ratio of their efficiencies.

Efficiency and Time

The **Efficiency** of a person is inversely proportional to the **Time** taken to complete the work (E = W/T). If total work W is constant, E₁/E₂ = T₂/T₁.

Combined Efficiency

The combined efficiency of two or more persons is the sum of their individual efficiencies (Eₜₒₜₐₗ = E₁ + E₂ + ...).

questions.question: Krishan invested a sum of Rs. 25,000 in two parts. He earned 11% p.a. simple interest on part 1 and 10% p.a. compound interest compounded annually on part 2. If the total interest received by him after 2 years is Rs. 5,370, then find the sum invested on simple interest.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Effective SI for 2 years at 11% = 22% and Effective CI for 2 years at 10% = 21%.

Overall interest % = (5370 ÷ 25000) × 100 = 21.48%.

By Alligation, Ratio of parts = (21.48 − 21) : (22 − 21.48) = 0.48 : 0.52 = 12 : 13.

Total ratio parts = 12 + 13 = 25 parts → ₹25,000.

Sum invested on SI (12 parts) = 12 × 1000 = ₹12,000.

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Total sum = ₹25,000

Rate for Part 1 (SI) = 11% p.a., Time = 2 years

Rate for Part 2 (CI) = 10% p.a., Time = 2 years

Total interest received = ₹5,370

**Formula Used:**

SI = (P × R × T) ÷ 100

CI Effective Rate = R + R + (R × R) ÷ 100

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3a58df1b05dbc284e5c19aa25efc7538dbf2dcfa1d0138d4f7557dcdec72c53.png] 

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the sum invested on SI be ₹x.

⇒ The sum invested on CI will be ₹(25000 − x).

⇒ Interest from Part 1 (SI) = (x × 11 × 2) ÷ 100 = 0.22x

⇒ Effective rate for CI at 10% for 2 years = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10) ÷ 100 = 21%

⇒ Interest from Part 2 (CI) = 21% of (25000 − x) = 0.21 × (25000 − x)

⇒ Total Interest = 0.22x + 0.21 × (25000 − x) = 5370

⇒ 0.22x + 5250 − 0.21x = 5370

⇒ 0.01x = 5370 − 5250

⇒ 0.01x = 120

⇒ x = 120 ÷ 0.01 = 12000

**∴ The correct answer is ₹12,000.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Effective Rate of Compound Interest

For 2 years, the effective CI rate can be directly calculated using the successive percentage formula: Rₑff = R + R + (R × R) ÷ 100.

Difference between CI and SI

The difference between compound interest and simple interest for 2 years on the same principal is given by the formula: D = P(R ÷ 100)².

Rule of Alligation

When a quantity is divided into two parts at different rates, the ratio of the parts is inversely proportional to the differences of their respective rates from the mean aggregate rate.
